question: For the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O phase change absorbent at the optimal desorption conditions, what regeneration efficiency was reached, and after five absorption-desorption cycles what remained?
expect: 94.7% at 393.15 K and 80 min; 88.6% of the initial value after five cycles (sec. 3.2)
rendered: Standard desorption conditions for the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O phase change absorbent were established as a desorption temperature of 393.15 K and a duration of 80 min. Under the optimized regeneration conditions, the regeneration efficiency was 94.7% at 393.15 K and 80 min. After five absorption-desorption cycles, the regeneration efficiency remained at 88.6% of its initial value.
